description: This file provides security utility functions for an API, including path resolution, validation, and filename sanitization.

methods.name: Path resolve_and_validate_path(user_path: str, *, must_exist: bool, allowed_root: Optional[Path])
methods.description: Resolves and validates a user-provided filesystem path, ensuring it is absolute, within an allowed root (if specified), and optionally exists.

methods.name: str sanitize_download_filename(filename: str, default: str = "output.csv")
methods.description: Sanitizes a filename for safe use in Content-Disposition headers by allowing only basic characters and applying defaults when necessary.

ctags.name: resolve_and_validate_path
ctags.pattern: /^def resolve_and_validate_path(user_path: str, *, must_exist: bool, allowed_root: Optional[Path])/
